name: Rethban Caverns
summary: In northwestern Redridge, gnolls hold the winding Rethban Caverns. The caves are the only source of uncommon Rethban ore.

sections.title: A Gnoll Warren
sections.body: Above Lake Everstill, the caverns shelter the local gnolls in a fortified redoubt. Their leader, Ardo Dirtpaw, commands a pack that guards the twisting passages and chambers below. Wander too near the hillside entrance, and they attack.

sections.title: The Veins of Rethban
sections.body: Blacksmiths and researchers in Lakeshire seek Rethban ore from these winding, dangerous tunnels. The Dirtpaw pack carries the distinct mineral, so travelers sent for samples must face the gnolls to find this rare mountain ore.

faq.answer: Rethban Caverns cut into the jagged bluffs of northwestern Redridge, north of the main road toward Lakeshire.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside Rethban Caverns?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls of the Dirtpaw clan dwell in the tunnels under their leader, Ardo Dirtpaw.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the caverns?
faq.answer: Travelers and townsfolk from Lakeshire seek uncommon Rethban ore, found deep in the caves and carried by the gnolls who live there.

angles.text: Rethban Caverns hold Rethban ore, a mineral deposit the local gnoll tribes fiercely contest.
The aggressive gnoll pack entrenched in Rethban Caverns threatens travelers in northern Redridge. Lakeshire's defenders must keep the bluffs secure.
